pages.text: Every forge starts with a $(item)Forge Hearth$(). Around it, within 7 blocks across and 4 up or down, it needs four stations, set out however you like:
pages.title: The Hearth

pages.text: $(li)a $(item)furnace$() or $(item)blast furnace$(), to heat metal$(li)an $(item)anvil$(), to strike it$(li)a $(item)cauldron$() of water (or oil), to quench it$(li)a $(item)grindstone$(), to finish it$(br2)Right-click the hearth to see what's missing. Its fire lights once the forge is complete; striking, quenching and grinding only work at stations near a lit hearth.

Decoration counts too. Bricks, stone and deepslate bricks, chains, lanterns, iron bars, barrels and the like near the hearth widen every sweet spot a little: +0.5% for every 8 blocks, up to +2.5%. A forge that looks like a forge works like one.
pages.title: A Proper Workshop
